Name: Nyapu Style Hat Mouse Lacey by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]Hat Mouse Lacey- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt[/center]
[/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

I finished several mods this week, so I hope you all enjoy the drops. :D (I'll publish one each day this weekend- Fri, Sat, Sun)

I am happy to have finally had the time to retexture this mod. I always thought Lacey was an adorable NPC, but I wanted to retexture her to my taste. I made her more anthropomorphic. I kind of want to create a more humanoid version of her in the future, but I think her current design turned out cute. I took some creative freedom with a couple of the portraits. I hope you enjoy the mod!

[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18177]Hat Mouse Lacey - NPC[/url]
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b]
[b]If you want all the seasonal outfits, make sure to select them in the GMCM Options[/b]! Go to Hat Mouse Lacey Core, under "Appearance," you'll see a check mark for Seasonal Outfits. I tried my best to code this CP mod. I am not an expert, and if you find any errors (or a better way to code this mod), please let me know. 

[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/188952864]ichortower[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.

[b]
